info.description: Use the endpoints below to access the summary-level data that powers the American Soccer Analysis web application.

parameters.name: player_id

parameters.description: Year of an MLS season. Lowest possible value is 2013. Can take a single year or multiple, comma-separated years (e.g., '2013,2014,2015'). Not specifying a year returns all available seasons. Cannot be combined with a date range.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of a date range. Must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Cannot be combined with `season_name`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of a date range. Must be a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Cannot be combined with `season_name`.

parameters.name: shot_pattern
parameters.description: Describes the possessing actions leading to the shot. Can take a single value or multiple, comma-separated values. Valid keywords include: 'Set piece', 'Corner', 'Free kick', 'Penalty', 'Fastbreak', and 'Regular'. Not specifying a value returns all shots.
